name: 01_oficina
voice: A mensagem chegou, mas a oficina não para. E se o pedido fosse registrado enquanto você trabalha? O Z mostra o caminho. Você recebe o contexto e continua a conversa. Zeey. Sua empresa, seu jeito.
prompts: A mechanic works under a car, the phone buzzes and lights up, he stops and looks worried, the little blue Z mascot blinks and reacts. 3D animated movie, fluid movements, preserve character design.
The mechanic picks up the phone and looks worried, customers wait behind him. The little blue Z floats closer and points at the screen, natural expressive animation, no text.
The little blue Z transforms into a glowing blue ribbon connecting the phone to a simple computer screen, the mechanic watches with surprise, cinematic 3D animation.
The mechanic smiles with relief and reads his phone, the little blue Z mascot waves and spins playfully, workshop lights glow, end on a confident warm composition.

name: 02_confeitaria
voice: Joana prepara os bolos. Uma cliente quer fazer uma encomenda. E se ela encontrasse as opções no site? O pedido chega organizado, e Joana confirma a disponibilidade. Zeey. Uma solução para a sua rotina.
prompts: The baker carefully decorates a cake, her phone buzzes with an incoming request, she looks up surprised, Z blinks. Charming 3D character animation, no text.
The busy baker glances from a cake to her phone and looks concerned. The small blue Z floats into view and waves to her, natural movement and expressive faces.
The blue Z transforms into a glowing blue ribbon, creating a simple floating website interface with cake images and clear shapes, the baker follows with her eyes. No words or text.
The baker checks the phone, nods and smiles as the little blue Z makes a happy celebratory spin beside a cake. Warm cinematic animation.

name: 03_atelie
voice: Uma mensagem no celular. Um pedido no site. Uma anotação no papel. Onde ficou a conversa? O Z conecta as informações para a equipe continuar de onde parou. Zeey. Tudo pode fazer mais sentido.
prompts: The business owner juggles a ringing phone and papers; notes slip off the desk, and she looks confused. The small blue Z watches with concern, lively 3D animation.
She searches through notes and looks between the laptop and the phone, the blue Z floats closer and gestures at the scattered papers. Expressive 3D animation.
The small blue Z stretches and becomes a blue glowing bridge, connecting the phone, website and computer screen. Papers fly gently into an orderly stack, cinematic animation.
The business owner sees the organized information on her screen, smiles and nods, blue Z reforms from the ribbon and waves. End on a bright reassuring shot.
